title: Pricing and cost-cutting perceptions
summary: Reviews in this topic focus on whether the G60 feels cost-effective or overpriced, with many fragments mentioning perceived cost-cutting but too little context to determine clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews describe the car as cost-effective or note pricing in a favorable comparison.

negative.summary: Negative reviews say the car feels expensive or reflects disappointing cost-cutting choices.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention cost cutting, charging cost, or cheaper competing alternatives, but the short fragments do not provide enough context for a clear sentiment classification.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are very short and lack context, which leaves many cost and cost-cutting mentions undetermined.
The topic mixes several related but distinct subjects, including purchase price, charging or fuel cost, feature deletions, and comparisons with Hyundai or older BMW models.
All examples come from the G60, so this summary does not speak to other models.
